Cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, avg(p.unitPrice) AS avg_price MATCH (s)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice > avg_price RETURN DISTINCT p.productName

Question: What are the names of products that have a unit price greater than the average unit price of products in their category?

answer: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, m.released AS released ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5
